title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra Model
excerpt: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, offering faster AI agents, visual reasoning, coding capabilities, and lower pricing.
body_html:
OpenAI has announced the release of GPT-6.1 Terra, a new model designed for everyday work, coding, visual reasoning, and computer use tasks.

According to the company, the new model introduces AI agents that operate three times faster while reducing pricing by 50 percent compared to larger models.

The release is aimed at improving efficiency and reducing costs for users leveraging AI across various tasks including software development and daily workflows.
